subject.title: [Feature]: openclaw models status --probe --all — per-model health check across all configured models

question: Should OpenClaw add a core `models status --probe --all` live configured-model sweep, and if so should it cover only configured text models or also image/per-agent/fallback surfaces?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear in source, but adding a live all-model probe changes CLI behavior, network cost, provider/rate-limit exposure, and JSON contract for a stable auth/provider diagnostics surface.

options.title: Approve scoped status-probe extension
options.body: Add `--all` to the existing `models status --probe` path with bounded concurrency, provider/profile filters, clear redaction, docs, and focused tests for configured text/fallback/image candidates.

options.title: Fold into broader model migration diagnostics
options.body: Keep this issue open but require a larger design that also covers fallback-chain testing and staged model migration before implementation starts.

options.title: Decline core CLI surface
options.body: Close as product-not-planned and steer users to scripts or plugins, accepting that configured stale model IDs remain outside core preflight diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped status-probe extension
recommendation.body: Add `--all` to the existing `models status --probe` path with bounded concurrency, provider/profile filters, clear redaction, docs, and focused tests for configured text/fallback/image candidates.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent feature-history signal across provider identity, auth health, and model status/probe behavior.
